documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018
Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter

analysis.summary: Management reported a strong financial performance for FY26 with significant growth in revenue, EBITDA, and net profit driven by fleet expansion, disciplined execution, and cost management. The company inducted the offshore support vessel Artemis and is preparing another offshore supply vessel and an MPSV for operations after dry docking and regulatory clearances. Looking ahead, management expects continued growth supported by favorable demand-supply dynamics, government maritime initiatives, and long-term contracts. Furthermore, the company maintains a conservative top-line growth expectation of 10% for the upcoming financial year while preserving stable EBITDA margins. ABS Marine Services Limited presented its financial and operational performance for the half year and year ended March 31, 2026, reporting total income of ₹322.64 Cr and a net profit of ₹80.80 Cr on a consolidated basis.

guidance.claim: Management expects a 10% increase in turnover from current levels for the financial year assuming all vessels run in the second half.
guidance.quote: As regards the guidance on the top line is concerned, we can expect a 10% increase -- assuming that all the vessels will be running in the second half. We can expect on the turnover front a 10% increase from the current levels.

guidance.claim: Management expects the EBITDA margin band of 45% to 50% to continue.
guidance.quote: As regards the EBITDA is concerned, I am sure that currently it is in the band of 45 to 50. I am sure that that will continue.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that favorable demand-supply dynamics in the offshore vessel market supported by an aging global fleet and limited new vessel additions continue to improve utilization levels and charter rates.
demand_outlook.quote: Additionally, favorable demand-supply dynamics in the offshore vessel market, supported by an aging global fleet and limited new vessel additions, continue to improve utilization levels and charter rates across segments.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that ONGC is anticipated to release a tender for about 20 vessels.
demand_outlook.quote: See, demand is as of -- as we talk now, ONGC is asking for about 20-vessel tender is going to come.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that during H2 FY26 the offshore support vessel Artemis was successfully inducted into the owned fleet.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of this strategy, during H2 FY26, we successfully inducted the offshore support vessel, Artemis, into our owned fleet, expanding our vessel ownership portfolio and improving our ability to participate in higher-value offshore projects.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that the company is scheduled to take delivery of an offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Further enhancing our offshore capabilities, we are also scheduled to take delivery of an offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: Management noted a total spend of about $15 million for both new vessels, Hades and MPSV.
capex_expansion.quote: Just a moment. We have totally, we have spent about $15 million for both the vessels.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated total income for FY26 stood at INR322.64 crores, registering a robust year-on-year growth of 75.05%.
margins_costs.quote: On a consolidated basis, total income stood at INR322.64 crores, registering a robust growth of 75.05% year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for FY26 increased by 179.17% to INR152.55 crores, with the EBITDA margin expanding by 1,763 basis points to 47.28%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased significantly by 179.17% to INR152.55 crores, while the EBITDA margin expanded sharply by 1,763 basis points to 47.28%.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax for FY26 rose by 196.45% to INR80.80 crores, with the PAT margin improving by 1,026 basis points to 25.04%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax rose by 196.45% to INR80.80 crores, with a PAT margin improving by 1,026 basis points to 25.04%.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that improved utilization levels, better margin realization, and disciplined cost management contributed to healthy growth in revenue and profitability.
margins_costs.quote: Improved utilization levels, better margin realization, and disciplined cost management have contributed to healthy growth in both revenue and profitability.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that out of eight owned vessels, five are on long-term charter, two have recently come out of charter, and a third newly acquired vessel requires dry docking before entering the market.
orders_capacity.quote: Out of the eight vessels that we own, five of them are on long-term charter, three of them -- two of them have just come out of charter, and third one is just we have acquired, so it has to go into the dry dock and then only come out and then only we put her in the market.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that the company operates a total of 12 vessels, which includes four smaller vessels on long-term charter running in Chennai and Ennore ports.
orders_capacity.quote: No, 12 number is correct. The other four vessels are smaller vessels, they are on long-term charter. They are pilot boat and security boat. Four of them, two of them running in Chennai Port and two of them are running in Ennore Port. So, totally we have a, you know, 12 vessels.

orders_capacity.claim: Top 10 clients contribute around 90% of revenue.
The company has secured over ₹350 Cr in strategic contracts.
orders_capacity.quote: Over ₹350 Cr in Strategic Contracts Secured

capital_allocation.claim: Management noted that under the tonnage tax scheme, the difference between corporate tax and tonnage tax is utilized for purchasing another vessel.
capital_allocation.quote: So, this what we do is whatever is, you know, between the corporate tax and the tonnage tax is used as for purchasing of another vessel.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that forward-looking statements are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties and assumptions that are difficult to predict.
risks_headwinds.quote: Such forward-looking statements are not guarantee of future performance and are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties and assumptions that are difficult to predict.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the vessel AM Passion is fixed at $19,000 per day for the next three years following the completion of the first three-year period.
management_commitments.quote: And then as of now, we are getting about $16,000 per day and that is fixed for three years. And then the next three years, it will be at $19,000.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
